summary: Android MediaProjection now reports its actual source dimensions to LiveKit, and the selected resolution profile is applied to the single RTP encoding with an aspect-preserving scale. The 1.0.0+3 release APK is signed and verified. Physical sender-stat/receiver playback acceptance remains open because no Android device is connected.

checks.name: Selected screen profile scale and portrait geometry
checks.observation: 21 tests passed. The tests cover all three resolution ceilings, landscape scaling, portrait source scaling, no upscaling for a source below the selected ceiling, and propagation of scaleResolutionDownBy to RTCRtpEncoding.

checks.name: Android signed release
checks.observation: Built from f1629739c2a9e7d536ac0322b389ebfe8a6709ea. aapt reports package ru.boohtacord.app, versionName 1.0.0 and versionCode 3.

checks.name: APK signing and certificate
checks.observation: APK Signature Scheme v2 verification passed with one RSA-4096 signer. Certificate SHA-256 is 394e369de2d566b4897493ee498da2f27745e514c49ca88c6489b0a811212b.

checks.name: macOS release cross-target compile
checks.observation: Built BOOHTACORD.app (92.4 MB). Xcode emitted an ld address/target-atom warning, but the release build completed successfully.

checks.name: macOS release bundle signature integrity
checks.observation: All nested frameworks and the app bundle are valid on disk and satisfy their designated requirement. This is local integrity verification, not Developer ID notarization or signed-Keychain acceptance.

checks.name: Physical sender profile and receiver playback
checks.observation: adb devices reports no connected Android device. Actual encoded dimensions/FPS across selected profiles and full-edge playback on web and Flutter receivers were not observed. This change does not claim to fix the previously reported receiver crop.

remaining: Install 1.0.0+3 on a physical Android device, run 720/1080/1440p profiles against two remote receivers, confirm portrait/landscape source edges and rotation/fullscreen playback, and compare actual sender/receiver dimensions and frame rate.
